steps.prompt_exact: I need a tiny offline phone-friendly browser board for planning a five-shot short video hook before generating anything: editable shot cards should help me keep the opening hook, repeated visual motif, product/object, and CTA continuous, then let me copy/export a concise shot brief.
steps.response_exact:
Here's your offline shot planner.

Five-shot short video hook planner with editable shot cards and continuity threads
5-shot hook planner

continuity threads
Opening hook
Visual motif
Product / object
CTA
1

Hook / pattern interrupt
Scene / action

Audio / VO

On-screen text
Caption overlay
Motif appearance
How motif shows up
Product in frame
How product appears
Duration (s)
e.g. 3
Prev

Copy brief

Here's your offline shot planner. How it works:

Continuity threads at the top are your global anchors — fill in the opening hook concept, your repeating visual motif, the product or hero object, and the CTA once. Then each card has a field to note how that shot specifically delivers on them, so nothing drifts across the sequence.

Five cards with a role reminder built in:

Open — pattern interrupt
Tension — amplify the problem or desire
Reveal — introduce the product or solution
Proof — benefit or social proof moment
Close — CTA + motif callback

Use the dots or Prev/Next to move between shots. Copy brief assembles everything into a clean plain-text block you can paste straight into a generation prompt, a notes app, or a team message — no internet needed.
